fact: An ATPE opinion piece says TASDJIL, from Technidev and ANATS, attributes a National Identification Number (NNI) to children when births are registered at the Koukou Angarana hospital desk.

Tchadinfos says that under TASDJIL a child's new birth certificate contains a national identification number (NNI), with registration desks in more than 50 maternity units and the aim of covering all health facilities; older certificates carry no NNI.
